jobs.title: Inference Performance Engineer
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE You'll own the cost and performance of our inference stack. Your work will determine how efficiently we serve models as workloads, traffic, and hardware change. You'll work closely with the engineers operating the serving fleet while owning the core performance levers: caching, batching, quantization, decoding, and kernel-level optimization. Success means improving throughput and latency without compromising reliability or model quality. RESPONSIBILITIES - Improve throughput, cost, and tail latency through KV-cache management, continuous batching, speculative decoding, and quantization. - Optimize long-context prefill and decode workloads based on real production traffic. - Tune routing between our infrastructure and external providers based on cost, capacity, and performance. - Work within serving engines such as vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM, going below the framework when needed. - Build profiling and measurement systems that show where time, memory, and compute are being spent. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years in ML systems, inference infrastructure, or performance engineering, with measurable improvements in cost or latency. - Deep understanding of model serving, including prefill and decode, memory bandwidth, batching, and concurrency. - Production experience with serving engines such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM. - Strong Python skills and proficiency in C++, Rust, or another systems language. - Experience with GPU performance, including CUDA, NCCL, mixed precis

You'll work directly with the founder to build a consistent, high-quality content presence across LinkedIn, X, and YouTube, turning the day-to-day reality of building a startup into content that grows an audience and drives business results. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 2 or more years creating and publishing content across social platforms such as LinkedIn, X, YouTube, or TikTok. - Demonstrated ability to write, shoot, and edit video content independently, without a production team. - A portfolio of published content showing platform-specific understanding, with different hooks and formats for

jobs.title: Head of Growth
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a senior leadership role at a fast-scaling AI SaaS company, reporting directly to the CEO. As Head of Growth, you will own the engine driving the vast majority of company revenue, manage a seven-figure monthly budget, and build a world-class growth team from the ground up. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and optimize the full growth funnel across performance marketing, SEO, creative strategy, and conversion rate optimization. - Drive product growth initiatives including funnel design, pricing strategy, positioning, and onboarding. - Build and scale a high-performing growth team by setting strategy and hiring top talent. - Make fast, data-driven decisions to allocate budget and prioritize initiatives across channels. - Lead expansion into new international markets and manage growth across geographies. - Report directly to the CEO on growth metrics, budget performance, and strategic priorities. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 8+ years in marketing or growth leadership roles, with a proven track record scaling companies from early stage to eight or nine-figure ARR. - Demonstrated experience owning and managing budgets of €15M+ annually with P&L accountability. - Deep expertise across performance marketing, SEO, CRO, website optimization, growth analytics, and lifecycle management. - Hands-on experience owning product growth levers: funnel design, pricing strategy, and positioning. - Proven success launching and scaling into new international markets with measurable revenue

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at a fast-growing AI voice and communication startup. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a senior mobile engineering role on a small, product-focused team building a consumer fintech app that helps everyday people manage cash flow, access earned wages early, and build credit. You will have meaningful ownership over the Android experience and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to ship features that directly affect user happiness. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, implement, and maintain a production-grade consumer Android application used by a growing base of real users. - Contribute to platform-level architecture and help scale core app infrastructure. - Solve engineering challenges pragmatically, balancing quality with speed in a startup environment. - Partner with product and design to shape the direction of new features and user experiences. - Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and business teams to align on clear objectives. - Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers on the mobile team. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - At least 5 years of professional mobile app development experience, with 2 or more years shipping production Android applications. - Strong Kotlin expertise, with hands-on experience using Jetpack Compose and modern app architecture patterns such as MVVM or Clean Architecture. - Experience integrating Firebase services including Authentication, Firestore or Realtime Database, and Cloud Messaging. - Familiarity with backend data formats and APIs common in mobile

jobs.title: Co-Founding CTO
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a co-founder-level CTO role at an early-stage startup building an AI-powered smart home intelligence platform. You will own the full technical vision, from IoT and embedded systems through to cloud and AI/ML layers, and your decisions will directly shape how connected properties detect anomalies, optimize energy, and manage their systems at scale. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and evolve the end-to-end technical architecture across IoT, cloud, and AI/ML layers. - Build and grow the engineering team, including hiring and mentoring engineers from the ground up. - Drive the technical side of the product roadmap, balancing innovation with practical execution. - Write production code and solve critical technical problems hands-on alongside your team. - Represent the technical vision to investors, partners, and other key stakeholders. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical leadership, with 3+ years in senior technical leadership roles. - Proven 0-to-1 startup experience as a co-founder or early CTO, not a big-company-only background. - Strong IoT and embedded systems background with hands-on experience shipping IoT products or systems. - Hardware and software crossover experience, with solid understanding of embedded and software systems integration. - Cloud architecture expertise, AWS preferred, with a track record of designing and deploying scalable systems. - AI/ML product experience applied to real-world, production e

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure/Site Reliability Engineer On-Call
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE This is a senior on-call SRE role at an early-stage AI infrastructure company, where you will be the technical expert enterprise clients depend on when critical systems fail. You will own incident response across Kubernetes clusters, Ceph storage, and bare metal servers, keeping high-value AI workloads running at all times. Your calm judgment and deep distributed systems expertise will have a direct and immediate impact on client operations. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Respond to and resolve production incidents across client infrastructure spanning Kubernetes, Ceph, and bare metal environments. - Troubleshoot complex distributed systems problems including pod scheduling failures, CNI networking issues, storage performance degradation, and hardware faults. - Handle escalations requiring deep expertise in etcd clusters, Ceph RGW authentication, Cilium networking, and bare metal load balancers. - Communicate directly with enterprise clients during incidents, providing clear status updates and resolution timelines. - Participate in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation with engineers across multiple time zones. - Document incidents thoroughly and improve runbooks based on recurring patterns. - Collaborate with the infrastructure team on long-term reliability improvements and automation to reduce incident frequency. jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Dedalus Labs builds persistent computers for AI agents. Our flagship product, Dedalus Machines, gives agents an isolated environment where they can run software, keep files and state, and work over time. We're looking for an infrastructure engineer who's bothered by a slow build, an unexplained latency spike, or a workflow that makes engineers do the same work twice. You want to understand where the time went. Then you want to fix it, measure the improvement, and make sure everyone who uses that system benefits from it. At a small startup, those details affect how quickly the whole company can move. A build that wastes ten minutes wastes them repeatedly. A confusing API slows every product built on it. A deployment that needs someone to supervise it interrupts work elsewhere. You'll seek out these problems across our systems and codebase, including the ones people have learned to tolerate. Your work can bring product releases and customer commitments forward by weeks, and over time, months. You'll work directly with our CTO and engineers, with substantial freedom to investigate, experiment, and choose an approach. We want someone who takes pride in the craft of software engineering and cares about the systems they'll leave for the next person. That means useful abstractions, clear failure behavior, tests that establish the right guarantees, and documentation that explains the decisions. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON Make the development loop faster. Our satellites operate in low Earth orbit to collect sunlight and enable a new class of capabilities—from powering on-orbit compute and transmitting energy via infrared lasers to delivering secure, high-bandwidth optical data. By rethinking how energy and data are generated and distributed in space, we are unlocking entirely new ways to operate in orbit and on Earth. Founded in 2024 by Baiju Bhatt (co-founder of Robinhood), Cowboy Space Corp. is backed by leading investors and built by a team from top aerospace and defense organizations. We are moving quickly to solve complex technical challenges and build a new category of space infrastructure. The Role As the Space Datacenter Architect, you will own the end-to-end technical architecture that turns accelerator-class compute into flight-ready, commercially useful infrastructure. This is not a traditional spacecraft payload or a ground datacenter moved into orbit. You will reconcile useful compute throughput with power generation, heat rejection, radiation, mass, launch loads, limited serviceability, and autonomous recovery. Your scope spans compute, networking, storage, power, cooling, platform firmware, infrastructure software, security, reliability, and test.
